title: Why Your Business Central Won't Scale to Finance & Operations
description:
Many IT leaders assume a growing company can simply upgrade from Business Central to Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations later. This episode explains why that bridge does not exist, why acquisitions hit the wall hardest, and how finance and IT teams can plan a realistic phased path before a deal forces their hand.
In this episode
00:00 – The Business Central to F&O trap02:53 – Upgrade vs. re-implementation05:45 – Two systems, two design philosophies13:25 – Why M&A is the real trigger16:10 – Dataverse, dual-write and the patchwork21:36 – Break-even: patchwork vs. migration26:49 – Process redesign and data cleanup41:47 – The phased path and common mistakes
Key takeaways
Business Central and Finance and Operations come from different lineages (NAV and AX), so moving between them is a full re-implementation rather than an upgrade.Acquisitions and multi-entity consolidation are what expose the gap, and Dataverse sync, dual-write and batch GL transfers only form a lagging patchwork.Plan early by designing the chart of accounts and master data for consolidation, documenting customizations and following a phased path with a parallel run.
Worth quoting
“Business central to finance and operations isn't that. It's not a newer version of the same thing, it's a full re-implementation, and those two words carry very different weight once you understand what's actually different underneath.” – Mirko Peters (03:36)
“growth in scale and growth in shape are two different things and only one of them runs you into this particular wall” – Mirko Peters (35:40)
